show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A thrilling reincarnation romance where a woman reborn from betrayal and death swears revenge—only to wake up married to her greatest enemy. As past hatred clashes with new emotions, she must decide whether to destroy him… or fall for him all over again.
